title: Relationships
scope: original independent supplementary exercises; not Cambridge content
source_alignment: Mindset Level 1 Unit 1 supplied reference screenshots pages 8-23; skill/sequence only

R-A.title: Grandparents and the Community Learning Club
R-A.text:
At the Riverside Community Learning Club, teenagers and older residents meet every Saturday morning. The club began in 2021 when a local teacher noticed that many young people wanted practical skills, while retired neighbours were looking for more opportunities to meet others. The first meeting attracted only twelve people. Today, the club usually welcomes more than forty visitors each week.

At the beginning of every session, everyone chooses an activity. Some teenagers learn how to repair bicycles, while others practise cooking simple dishes. Older residents often teach these skills, but the lessons are not one-way. Teenagers help their neighbours learn to use smartphones and send photographs to relatives who live far away. Both age groups say that exchanging knowledge makes them feel useful.

The organisers interviewed thirty club members last spring. Twenty-two said they had made a new friend from a different generation. Eighteen reported that they now spoke to an older family member more frequently. These were responses to a small local questionnaire, so they should not be treated as results for the whole country. However, they suggested that regular conversations might strengthen relationships.

One participant, Mina, used to avoid talking to her grandfather because she thought they had nothing in common. After attending a gardening workshop, she discovered that he had worked on a farm for many years. She now calls him every Sunday to ask about growing vegetables. She says that listening carefully is more helpful than trying to impress him with difficult words.

Not everyone can attend the club each week. Some members work at weekends and others need to care for young children. To include these people, the organisers prepare a free monthly newsletter. It describes upcoming meetings and shares short stories from members. The club hopes to open a second group next year, but that plan still depends on finding another suitable room.

R-B.title: Do Digital Messages Make Friendships Stronger?
R-B.text:
Keeping friendships strong can become difficult when people move to different cities. A short message may help, but different people expect different kinds of contact. At Hilltop College, a student group asked 68 volunteers how they kept in touch with friends after leaving school. This informal project did not measure the quality of every friendship. It simply described what the volunteers said.

Some students liked sending pictures or short voice messages because these methods were quick and convenient. Others preferred a longer video call once a month. One student explained that her closest friend often worked late, so she rarely expected an immediate reply. They arranged a call on the first Sunday of each month instead. The important point for them was keeping a regular promise, not talking every day.

The project also found that friendships need attention away from screens. Several volunteers said they met friends at a sports centre or cooked together when they lived nearby. These activities gave them something enjoyable to discuss later. However, a few participants felt stressed when they saw friends spending time with other people online. They sometimes misunderstood photographs and believed they were being excluded.

A college counsellor who read the responses suggested asking clear questions rather than making quick assumptions. If a friend does not reply, they may simply be busy. The counsellor also encouraged students to respect different communication habits. The results did not prove that technology improves or damages friendship. Instead, they showed that trust, realistic expectations and shared activities can all play a part in maintaining relationships.

A.title: A family reunion reservation
A.transcript:
Receptionist: Good morning, Willow Hall. What can I do for you?
Caller: Hello. I want to book a room for a family reunion.
Receptionist: Certainly. Are you expecting eighteen guests?
Caller: We first thought eighteen, but four cousins cannot come. So the final number is fourteen.
Receptionist: I understand. Would Saturday the ninth be suitable?
Caller: Sorry, we need the following Saturday, the sixteenth.
Receptionist: The small room holds twelve, but the garden room holds twenty-four. I recommend the garden room.
Caller: That sounds good. What is the price?
Receptionist: The room is ninety pounds. The cleaning fee is fifteen pounds, so the total is one hundred and five pounds.
Caller: Fine. My surname is Patel, P-A-T-E-L.
Receptionist: Thank you. We can hold the reservation until Friday.

B.title: Choosing a graduation present
B.transcript:
Assistant: Welcome to Maple Gift Shop. Are you looking for something special?
Customer: Yes, a graduation present for my sister. I considered a silver necklace, but she already has one.
Assistant: How about this blue travel journal? It costs twenty-eight pounds.
Customer: I like it, although I was planning to spend about twenty pounds.
Assistant: We have a smaller green journal for eighteen pounds. There is also a black notebook for sixteen.
Customer: The green journal sounds perfect. Is the gift wrapping included?
Assistant: Basic wrapping is free. A decorative box costs four pounds extra.
Customer: I'll take the green journal with free wrapping, please.
Assistant: Of course. The total is eighteen pounds.
Customer: Great. She will use it during her trip after graduation.

C.title: A community celebration
C.transcript:
Speaker one: Are you coming to the neighbourhood welcome afternoon?
Speaker two: Yes. I thought it was a birthday party, but the invitation says it is a welcome event for new residents.
Speaker one: Exactly. People from the same street will meet for the first time.
Speaker two: Do we need to bring food?
Speaker one: The organisers are providing sandwiches. Guests can bring fruit if they want, but they do not have to.
Speaker two: I have a red scarf to wear. Is there a dress code?
Speaker one: No, people can wear any colour. The organisers will give everyone a small paper badge.
Speaker two: What does the badge mean?
Speaker one: It shows which activity group you are in. The colour does not tell people where you live.
Speaker two: And what time does everything begin?
Speaker one: The doors open at two thirty, but the games start at three.
Speaker two: Thanks. I'll come a little early.

D.title: Weekend habits interview
D.transcript:
Interviewer: Tell me how you usually spend time with your family.
Student: We often cook together on Saturday evenings, usually around six. My brother rarely joins us because he works at a cafe.
Interviewer: Do you ever visit your grandparents?
Student: Yes, we normally visit them twice a month. They live near a small lake, about twenty minutes from our home.
Interviewer: What do you do there?
Student: We sometimes walk beside the lake, but we usually play board games indoors.
Interviewer: Do you spend time with friends as well?
Student: Definitely. I meet a close friend after school on Wednesdays. We sometimes study together and then play badminton.
Interviewer: Is anyone in your family similar to you?
Student: My older sister is. We both enjoy reading, although she prefers history and I like science.

E.title: Speaking model: describing family
E.transcript:
Examiner: Please tell me a little about your family.
Candidate: I come from a small but close-knit family. My parents are supportive, and my older sister is a reliable person. We often prepare dinner together at weekends. Even though our schedules are different, we have strong family ties.

F.title: Speaking samples: short, relevant and off-topic
F.transcript:
Examiner: Do you often spend time with your family?
Student one: Yes.
Examiner: Thank you. Student two?
Student two: Yes, I usually spend Sunday afternoons with them. We cook lunch together, and it gives us time to talk about our week.
Examiner: Thank you. Student three?
Student three: The history of the city is fascinating, and there are many interesting buildings in my neighbourhood.

G.title: Pronunciation drill: present simple endings
G.transcript:
Voice: Listen and repeat. Cooks. Plays. Watches. Helps. Reads. Visits.
Voice: My mother cooks every evening. My father plays football. My sister watches films. My brother reads books.

W-A.title: Preparing a neighbourhood welcome pack (6 stages)
stages: Collect blank cards and paper bags
Print street maps on recycled paper
Place cards and maps inside bags
Deliver finished packs to new residents

W-B.title: Producing reusable cloth gift bags (8 stages)
stages: Pack and deliver the finished bags

activities.title: Family tree warm-up
activities.instruction_en: Write the correct family word.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết từ chỉ quan hệ gia đình phù hợp.

items.question: Your mother’s brother is your ____.
items.explanation_en: Your mother and her brother share parents; he is your uncle.
items.explanation_vi: Anh/em trai của mẹ thuộc vai chú/cậu/bác trai trong tiếng Việt; tiếng Anh dùng uncle.

items.question: Your aunt’s daughter is your ____.
items.explanation_en: A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
items.explanation_vi: Con của cô/dì/chú/bác/cậu là cousin, không phải niece.

items.question: Your sister’s son is your ____.
items.explanation_en: A nephew is the son of your brother or sister.
items.explanation_vi: Con trai của anh/chị/em ruột là nephew; nếu là con gái: niece.

activities.title: Predict before reading
activities.instruction_en: Before reading Passage A, answer from the title; these are predictions, not marked factual answers.
activities.instruction_vi: Dựa vào nhan đề bài đọc A để dự đoán; không chấm đúng/sai theo nội dung.

items.question: What might older and younger neighbours teach each other?
items.answer: Possible: cooking or bicycle repair; smartphone skills.
items.explanation_en: Predictions activate vocabulary and a reading purpose. Check them against the text afterwards.
items.explanation_vi: Dự đoán giúp kích hoạt vốn từ; đọc xong đối chiếu chứ không suy đoán đáp án từ kiến thức cá nhân.

items.question: Which phrase in the title suggests more than one age group?
items.explanation_en: The title suggests an activity where generations may meet.
items.explanation_vi: Tên bài gợi một hoạt động chung giữa nhiều thế hệ; xác minh trong bài.

activities.title: Vocabulary from context
activities.instruction_en: Choose the most accurate meaning in the passage.
activities.instruction_vi: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh chọn nghĩa đúng của từ/cụm từ.

items.question: In Passage A, “retired neighbours” means people who have ____.
items.explanation_en: Retired describes people who have left regular employment, often because of age.
items.explanation_vi: Retired = đã nghỉ hưu; không có nghĩa là cô đơn hay thất nghiệp trong tình huống này.

items.question: In Passage A, “one-way” lessons means knowledge moves ____.
items.explanation_en: The next sentence says teenagers teach older people too, showing the club is not one-way.
items.explanation_vi: Câu kế giải thích thanh thiếu niên cũng dạy người lớn, nên one-way là một chiều.

items.question: In Passage A, “suitable” most nearly means ____.
items.explanation_en: A suitable room is a room that meets the practical needs of the group.
items.explanation_vi: Suitable = phù hợp; trong bài là một căn phòng đáp ứng nhu cầu sinh hoạt.

activities.title: Find precise phrases
activities.instruction_en: Find the exact expression in Passage A.
activities.instruction_vi: Quét bài A để tìm đúng cụm từ mang nghĩa cho trước.

items.question: Find the phrase meaning “every week on Saturday morning”.
items.explanation_en: Look for the frequency phrase in the opening line.
items.explanation_vi: Tìm trạng ngữ thời gian ở câu mở đầu; không phải suy luận.

items.question: Find the three-word phrase for “a questionnaire in one area”.
items.explanation_en: The passage warns that the sample cannot describe a whole country.
items.explanation_vi: Bài dùng cụm này để nhấn mạnh nghiên cứu phạm vi hẹp.

items.question: Find the phrase about speaking to someone by phone each week.
items.explanation_en: Locate Mina’s routine and match “each week” to “every Sunday”.
items.explanation_vi: “Each week” được diễn đạt bằng “every Sunday”; cần nhận ra paraphrase.

activities.title: Underline key words
activities.instruction_en: Identify the critical keywords before locating answers.
activities.instruction_vi: Gạch chân từ khóa quan trọng trước khi tìm bằng chứng.

items.question: Question: How many members were interviewed last spring? Which keywords carry meaning?
items.explanation_en: The question word HOW MANY signals a number; the person and date locate the fact.
items.explanation_vi: How many báo hiệu số lượng; “members” và “last spring” xác định đúng câu.

items.question: Question: How often does Mina call her grandfather?
items.explanation_en: How often asks frequency, not call duration or time of day.
items.explanation_vi: How often hỏi tần suất; không trả lời thời lượng cuộc gọi.

activities.title: Scan for answers
activities.instruction_en: Answer with NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from Passage A.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời không quá 3 từ và/hoặc 1 con số; lấy từ bài A.

items.question: In which year did the club begin?
items.explanation_en: The first paragraph explicitly states that the club began in 2021.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn 1 cho trực tiếp năm 2021; chỉ viết số, không thêm “in”.

items.question: How many club members completed the questionnaire?
items.explanation_en: The third paragraph states that organisers interviewed thirty members.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn 3 có “thirty club members”; “thirty” là đủ và đúng giới hạn.

items.question: What does the club send to members who cannot attend?
items.explanation_en: The final paragraph names the free monthly newsletter.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn cuối nói bản tin hàng tháng; chỉ điền cụm danh từ phù hợp.

activities.title: Find the answer error
activities.instruction_en: Each answer is flawed. Name the error.
activities.instruction_vi: Xác định lỗi: sai dữ kiện, vượt giới hạn từ, sai chính tả hoặc tự đổi từ.

items.question: Q: Which document is prepared for members who cannot attend? Proposed answer: “a free monthly newsletter for members”. Limit: TWO WORDS.
items.explanation_en: The proposed answer exceeds two words. The passage uses “monthly newsletter” as a suitable two-word answer.
items.explanation_vi: Câu gợi ý vượt quá hai từ. Đáp án từ văn bản là “monthly newsletter”, đúng giới hạn.

items.question: Q: What is Mina’s hobby? Proposed answer: “swimming”
items.explanation_en: The text describes a gardening workshop, not swimming.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án bịa “swimming”; phải bám thông tin trong bài.

items.question: Q: Which document does the club send? Proposed answer: “newslatter”
items.explanation_en: The correct spelling is “newsletter”. IELTS short answers must be spelled correctly.
items.explanation_vi: Sai chính tả newsletter; IELTS không chấp nhận lỗi viết sai từ khóa.

activities.title: Repair weak answers
activities.instruction_en: Rewrite using only words from Passage A, maximum THREE WORDS.
activities.instruction_vi: Sửa đáp án bằng từ trong bài A, tối đa 3 từ.

items.question: How often does Mina phone her grandfather? Weak answer: “she does it once every seven days”.
items.explanation_en: The text gives the exact phrase, shorter and within the word limit.
items.explanation_vi: Đáp án “every Sunday” xuất hiện trực tiếp; không thêm câu hoàn chỉnh.

items.question: Who helps older neighbours with phones? Weak answer: “their amazing grandchildren”.
items.explanation_en: The passage says teenagers help neighbours, not necessarily their own grandparents.
items.explanation_vi: Không tự suy ra quan hệ ông cháu; chỉ đáp án teenagers.

items.question: What type of newsletter is prepared? Weak answer: “an expensive newsletter”.
items.explanation_en: The source says the newsletter is free and monthly.
items.explanation_vi: Hai đặc điểm của bản tin được nêu trực tiếp; tránh từ trái nghĩa expensive.

activities.title: Grammar in reading: present simple
activities.instruction_en: Choose present simple or present continuous and explain why.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn thì đúng và giải thích lý do.

items.question: The club (meets / is meeting) every Saturday.
items.explanation_en: “Every Saturday” describes a regular habit, so present simple is natural.
items.explanation_vi: “Every Saturday” chỉ thói quen lặp lại nên dùng hiện tại đơn.

items.question: Look! The members (prepare / are preparing) the room now.
items.explanation_en: “Look!” and “now” describe an action happening at the moment.
items.explanation_vi: Look và now là dấu hiệu hành động đang diễn ra: hiện tại tiếp diễn.

activities.title: Adverbs of frequency
activities.instruction_en: Identify the frequency adverb in each sentence.
activities.instruction_vi: Tìm trạng từ chỉ tần suất.

items.question: The club usually welcomes more than forty visitors.
items.explanation_en: Usually indicates a common habit; it comes before the main verb “welcomes”.
items.explanation_vi: Usually = thường; đứng trước động từ thường welcomes.

items.question: Mina now calls her grandfather every Sunday.
items.explanation_en: This is a frequency expression rather than a single-word adverb.
items.explanation_vi: Every Sunday là cụm trạng ngữ tần suất (không phải trạng từ đơn lẻ).

items.question: Older residents often teach practical skills.
items.explanation_en: Often marks repeated action; its position is before the main verb.
items.explanation_vi: Often = thường xuyên, đứng trước teach.

activities.title: Position of adverbs
activities.instruction_en: Reorder the words to create a correct sentence.
activities.instruction_vi: Sắp xếp từ thành câu hoàn chỉnh.

items.question: usually / is / my grandmother / cheerful
items.explanation_en: With the verb BE, put usually after am/is/are.
items.explanation_vi: Với be, trạng từ tần suất đứng sau am/is/are.

items.question: my cousin / often / sends / pictures
items.explanation_en: With an ordinary main verb, “often” normally comes before it.
items.explanation_vi: Trước động từ thường sends, đặt often.

items.question: never / I / forget / her birthday
items.explanation_en: The adverb follows the subject and precedes the main verb.
items.explanation_vi: Never đứng giữa chủ ngữ I và động từ forget.

activities.title: Exam practice: short-answer reading
activities.instruction_en: Read Passage B and answer. NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
activities.instruction_vi: Đọc bài B, mỗi câu không quá 3 từ và/hoặc số.

items.question: How many volunteers took part in the student project?
items.explanation_en: The opening paragraph states 68 volunteers.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn mở đầu nêu 68 tình nguyện viên; viết đúng số.

items.question: When did one pair of friends arrange their monthly call?
items.explanation_en: The passage says the first Sunday of each month.
items.explanation_vi: “The first Sunday of each month” → first Sunday vừa đúng nghĩa vừa không vượt số từ.

items.question: Which facility did some volunteers use to meet friends?
items.explanation_en: The third paragraph lists a sports centre as a meeting location.
items.explanation_vi: Câu nói nơi bạn bè gặp nhau ở sports centre.

items.question: Who advised students to ask clear questions?
items.explanation_en: The last paragraph identifies a college counsellor.
items.explanation_vi: Đoạn cuối gọi đúng chức danh college counsellor.

items.question: What should friends respect about one another?
items.explanation_en: This exact noun phrase appears in the final paragraph.
items.explanation_vi: Cụm danh từ trong đoạn cuối; khác biệt thói quen giao tiếp.

activities.title: Process topic lead-in
activities.instruction_en: Discuss a celebration and name a preparation step.
activities.instruction_vi: Nói về buổi lễ và nêu một bước chuẩn bị.

items.question: Describe one thing your family prepares before a celebration.
items.answer: Sample: We prepare a guest list before the celebration.
items.explanation_en: A process describes actions in sequence, not just the final product.
items.explanation_vi: Bài process cần thể hiện hành động theo thứ tự, không chỉ nói kết quả cuối.

items.question: Which comes first: invite guests or welcome them at the venue?
items.explanation_en: Invitations happen before guests arrive.
items.explanation_vi: Mời khách trước thời điểm đón tiếp; đây là tư duy thứ tự bước.

activities.title: Materials and equipment
activities.instruction_en: Choose the correct label for each object description.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn tên vật liệu/dụng cụ phù hợp với mô tả.

items.question: A machine that puts ink onto paper is a ____.
items.explanation_en: A printer produces text or images on paper.
items.explanation_vi: Printer = máy in; không nhầm với paper cutter.

items.question: A thin material made from cotton is ____.
items.explanation_en: Fabric is cloth used for sewing bags or clothing.
items.explanation_vi: Fabric = vải; nguyên liệu cho túi tái sử dụng.

items.question: A tool used to cut paper or fabric into shapes is a pair of ____.
items.explanation_en: Scissors cut material; they are not a container.
items.explanation_vi: Scissors = kéo; đi với a pair of vì danh từ dạng số nhiều.

activities.title: Group process words
activities.instruction_en: Classify words: recycled paper, needle, soft, scissors, cotton, rectangular.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân loại thành material, tool và adjective.

items.question: Which two are materials?
items.explanation_en: Materials are substances the product is made from.
items.explanation_vi: Materials = nguyên liệu: recycled paper, cotton.

items.question: Which two are tools?
items.explanation_en: Tools perform an action during production.
items.explanation_vi: Tools = dụng cụ: kim và kéo.

items.question: Which two describe shape or texture?
items.explanation_en: Soft describes texture; rectangular describes shape.
items.explanation_vi: Soft là mềm, rectangular là hình chữ nhật.

activities.title: Read a six-step diagram
activities.instruction_en: Look at Diagram W-A. Put these actions into sequence.
activities.instruction_vi: Xem sơ đồ W-A, xếp hành động theo thứ tự.

items.question: Which comes before folding: printing maps or delivering packs?
items.explanation_en: Maps are printed at step 2, while delivery happens at step 6.
items.explanation_vi: In bản đồ ở bước 2, giao quà ở bước 6; cần đọc mũi tên.

items.question: What is the final stage?
items.explanation_en: Step 6 is delivery; a process overview can name its first and last stages.
items.explanation_vi: Bước cuối là chuyển bộ quà; overview nên tóm điểm bắt đầu/kết thúc.

items.question: Which steps are the packing stage?
items.explanation_en: Welcome cards are written in step 4 and placed into bags in step 5.
items.explanation_vi: Bước 4 viết thẻ, bước 5 xếp các vật vào túi; nhận diện nhóm công đoạn.

activities.title: Present simple passive
activities.instruction_en: Use AM/IS/ARE + past participle in each sentence.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng bị động hiện tại đơn: am/is/are + V3.

items.question: The maps ____ (print) on recycled paper.
items.explanation_en: Maps is plural, so ARE + PRINTED. The agent is less important than the action.
items.explanation_vi: Maps số nhiều → are; print V3 = printed. Bị động tập trung vào công đoạn.

items.question: Each name ____ (write) on a card.
items.explanation_en: Each name is singular; WRITE has irregular past participle WRITTEN.
items.explanation_vi: Each name số ít → is; write → written.

items.question: The bags ____ (deliver) to new neighbours.
items.explanation_en: Plural subject bags takes ARE + DELIVERED.
items.explanation_vi: Bags số nhiều → are delivered; không dùng are deliver.

activities.title: Sequencing expressions
activities.instruction_en: Fill with First, Next, After that, Finally. Use each once.
activities.instruction_vi: Điền First, Next, After that, Finally, mỗi từ một lần.

items.question: ____, the used fabric is collected.
items.explanation_en: First introduces the beginning stage.
items.explanation_vi: First mở đầu quy trình, có thể kèm dấu phẩy.

items.question: ____, the fabric is inspected for damage.
items.explanation_en: Next shows the immediate following step.
items.explanation_vi: Next nối bước tiếp theo theo trình tự.

items.question: ____, it is washed and dried.
items.explanation_en: After that refers to an earlier completed action.
items.explanation_vi: After that = sau đó; giúp nhóm bước trong body.

items.question: ____, the bags are packed for delivery.
items.explanation_en: Finally signals the last stage.
items.explanation_vi: Finally dẫn bước cuối, không dùng cho bước giữa.

activities.title: Introduction or overview?
activities.instruction_en: Identify whether a sentence is an INTRODUCTION or an OVERVIEW.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân biệt Introduction và Overview.

items.question: “The diagram illustrates how recycled cloth bags are produced.”
items.explanation_en: This paraphrases the task and identifies what is shown, without summarising stages.
items.explanation_vi: Câu mở bài giới thiệu sơ đồ, chưa nêu đặc điểm tổng quát.

items.question: “Overall, the process contains eight stages, starting with collection and ending with delivery.”
items.explanation_en: It summarises the number of stages and the beginning/end, without detailed measurements.
items.explanation_vi: Overview nêu số giai đoạn và điểm đầu-cuối; không liệt kê từng thao tác.

activities.title: Choose the stronger overview
activities.instruction_en: Select the more suitable IELTS Task 1 overview.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn overview phù hợp hơn.

items.question: A “The workers should wash the cloth carefully.” / B “Overall, used fabric passes through preparation, sewing and inspection before delivery.”
items.explanation_en: B reports the process objectively. A gives advice, which Task 1 should not do.
items.explanation_vi: B khách quan, khái quát các giai đoạn; A là lời khuyên nên không đúng yêu cầu.

items.question: A “There are eight stages from collection to distribution.” / B “I think these bags are wonderful and should be popular.”
items.explanation_en: A states a useful overall feature; B adds personal opinion.
items.explanation_vi: Task 1 không thêm quan điểm cá nhân; overview cần tóm tắt đặc điểm chính.

activities.title: Analyse a model paragraph
activities.instruction_en: Read the short original model below and answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Đọc đoạn mẫu gốc và phân tích.

items.question: MODEL: “The diagram shows how a neighbourhood welcome pack is assembled. Overall, six stages are involved, from collecting supplies to delivering the completed packs. First, blank cards and bags are collected. Maps are then printed and folded before names are written on the cards. Finally, both items are placed in the bags and delivered to residents.” Which sentence is the overview?
items.answer: Overall, six stages are involved, from collecting supplies to delivering the completed packs.
items.explanation_en: The second sentence summarises the whole process.
items.explanation_vi: Câu thứ 2 có Overall; tóm số bước và điểm đầu-cuối.

items.question: Find two present simple passive verbs in the model.
items.explanation_en: Both are BE + past participle, useful for processes without a named agent.
items.explanation_vi: Hai cấu trúc are + V3; tập trung vào vật được xử lý.

items.question: Find a sequencing expression for the last action.
items.explanation_en: Finally introduces the final stage of the process.
items.explanation_vi: Finally báo hiệu bước cuối.

activities.title: Guided practice with a second process
activities.instruction_en: Look at Diagram W-B and write stage sentences.
activities.instruction_vi: Xem sơ đồ W-B và viết câu mô tả từng bước.

items.question: Write one passive sentence for stage 3.
items.answer: The fabric is washed in warm water.
items.explanation_en: Subject fabric is uncountable/singular; use is washed.
items.explanation_vi: Fabric là danh từ không đếm được, dùng is washed.

items.question: Write one passive sentence for stage 6.
items.answer: The sides are stitched and handles are added.
items.explanation_en: Both plural subjects need ARE + past participle.
items.explanation_vi: Sides/handles đều số nhiều; dùng are stitched / are added.

items.question: Write one overview for the eight-stage diagram.
items.answer: Overall, the process has eight stages, from collecting used cotton to delivering finished bags.
items.explanation_en: Name the total stages and opening/end point; do not list all details.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu số bước và đầu/cuối thay vì kể toàn bộ.

activities.title: Exam task: process description
activities.instruction_en: Write at least 150 words on Diagram W-B, with introduction, overview and two body paragraphs.
activities.instruction_vi: Viết ít nhất 150 từ mô tả sơ đồ W-B, gồm introduction, overview và 2 body.

items.question: Write a complete Task 1 response (150+ words).
items.answer: See the full model and rubric in the teacher guide.
items.explanation_en: A complete report needs accurate sequencing, overview, neutral tone and passive constructions. It must not invent data.
items.explanation_vi: Bài đạt yêu cầu khi đủ ít nhất 150 từ, có overview, mô tả đúng thứ tự, dùng bị động, không bịa thêm chi tiết.

activities.title: Predict the conversation setting
activities.instruction_en: Choose TWO everyday situations likely to involve a customer and a service worker.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn HAI tình huống thường có khách hàng và nhân viên.

items.question: A planning a booking; B discussing a philosophical theory; C buying a present; D presenting a science lecture
items.explanation_en: Booking a venue and buying a gift naturally involve service interactions.
items.explanation_vi: Đặt phòng và mua quà là hội thoại dịch vụ thường gặp ở Listening Part 1.

activities.title: Match recordings to situations
activities.instruction_en: Listen to A and B. Match each audio to a situation.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe A, B rồi nối với tình huống phù hợp.

items.question: Recording A: room booking / buying stationery?
items.explanation_en: The caller wants to book a room for a family reunion.
items.explanation_vi: Clip A có mục đích đặt phòng cho buổi đoàn tụ gia đình.

items.question: Recording B: gift purchase / medical visit?
items.explanation_en: The customer chooses a graduation present and asks about wrapping.
items.explanation_vi: Clip B nói về chọn quà tốt nghiệp và gói quà.

activities.title: Who is speaking?
activities.instruction_en: Listen to A and B. Identify the two roles in each conversation.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe A, B để xác định vai người nói (không suy ra giới tính nếu chỉ từ bản chép).

items.question: Who answers the phone in Recording A?
items.explanation_en: The opening line is a service greeting from Willow Hall.
items.explanation_vi: Người bắt máy là receptionist (nhân viên lễ tân).

items.question: Who is looking for a graduation present in Recording B?
items.explanation_en: The customer explains the need to buy a gift.
items.explanation_vi: Người mua là customer. Nhận diện vai đáng tin hơn suy giới tính từ văn bản.

activities.title: Listen for a choice
activities.instruction_en: Listen again and choose A or B.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe lại và chọn A hoặc B.

items.question: Recording A: Which room is recommended? A Small room B Garden room
items.explanation_en: The small room holds only twelve, but the caller needs fourteen seats.
items.explanation_vi: Phòng nhỏ chỉ 12 chỗ, có 14 khách; nên garden room.

items.question: Recording B: Which present is finally bought? A Silver necklace B Green journal
items.explanation_en: The customer considers a necklace but finally chooses the green journal.
items.explanation_vi: Người mua nhắc necklace để gây nhiễu, quyết định cuối là green journal.

activities.title: Number discrimination
activities.instruction_en: Listen to A and B. Write the number you hear in context.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe A, B và ghi số đúng theo ngữ cảnh.

items.question: A: How many guests are coming in the end?
items.explanation_en: Eighteen is the initial plan; four guests cancel, leaving fourteen.
items.explanation_vi: 18 là kế hoạch đầu, 4 người không tới -> 14 khách.

items.question: A: Which date is chosen?
items.explanation_en: The speaker rejects the ninth and requests the sixteenth.
items.explanation_vi: Mùng 9 là thông tin nhiễu; chọn ngày 16.

items.question: B: What is the price of the green journal?
items.explanation_en: The green journal costs eighteen, while the blue journal costs twenty-eight.
items.explanation_vi: Green journal = £18; £28 thuộc món khác.

activities.title: Numbers in a booking
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Recording A. Choose correct details.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe clip A; chọn thông tin cuối cùng.

items.question: Number of guests: A 12 B 14 C 18
items.explanation_en: The final headcount is fourteen after cancellations.
items.explanation_vi: 12 là sức chứa phòng nhỏ, 18 dự kiến ban đầu, 14 mới đúng.

items.question: Date: A 9th B 16th C 19th
items.explanation_en: The caller corrects the suggested ninth to the sixteenth.
items.explanation_vi: Người gọi sửa từ ngày 9 thành 16.

activities.title: Follow corrected information
activities.instruction_en: Fill the final details after the speaker changes an earlier answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Chỉ ghi thông tin cuối cùng sau khi người nói sửa.

items.question: Initial group size 18 -> final group size ____
items.explanation_en: The correction “four cousins cannot come” changes the final answer.
items.explanation_vi: Thông tin sửa sau cùng mới được lấy; 18 - 4 = 14.

items.question: Suggested day 9th -> required day ____
items.explanation_en: The second number follows “Sorry, we need...”
items.explanation_vi: “Sorry, we need...” báo người nói sửa ngày.

activities.title: Calculate the total
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Recording A and select the total booking cost.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe A, chọn tổng tiền gồm phụ phí.

items.question: A £90 B £105 C £115
items.explanation_en: £90 room charge + £15 cleaning fee = £105 total.
items.explanation_vi: £90 tiền phòng + £15 vệ sinh = £105; không chọn giá cơ bản.

activities.title: Gift prices and offers
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Recording B. Choose the correct answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe B để phân biệt giá gốc và khoản thêm.

items.question: The small green journal costs A £16 B £18 C £28
items.explanation_en: The black notebook is £16 and blue journal £28; green is £18.
items.explanation_vi: £16 thuộc sổ đen, £28 thuộc sổ xanh dương; sổ xanh lá £18.

items.question: Decorative gift-box cost: A free B £4 C £8
items.explanation_en: Wrapping is free, but the extra decorative box costs four pounds.
items.explanation_vi: Gói cơ bản miễn phí, hộp trang trí cộng £4.

activities.title: Complete a transcript extract
activities.instruction_en: Listen to B and write the missing words/numbers.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe B và điền từ/số vào đoạn tóm tắt.

items.question: The customer takes the ____ journal.
items.explanation_en: The final decision is green, not blue.
items.explanation_vi: Màu được chốt là green.

items.question: Basic wrapping is ____.
items.explanation_en: The assistant explicitly states that basic wrapping is free.
items.explanation_vi: Free là miễn phí, khác hộp trang trí £4.

items.question: The final total is ____ pounds.
items.explanation_en: The assistant gives the final amount after the customer declines the box.
items.explanation_vi: Không cộng £4 do không mua hộp trang trí.

activities.title: Recognise paraphrases
activities.instruction_en: Match the phrase to a meaning you hear.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghép cụm từ với cách diễn đạt tương đương trong bài nghe.

items.question: “a present for finishing university” = ?
items.explanation_en: A graduation present celebrates finishing a course of study.
items.explanation_vi: Quà tốt nghiệp = graduation present.

items.question: “not required to bring anything” = ?
items.explanation_en: In Recording C, guests may bring fruit but do not have to.
items.explanation_vi: Do not have to = không bắt buộc, khác must not = bị cấm.

activities.title: Predict the answer type
activities.instruction_en: Before listening to C, decide what type of information is needed.
activities.instruction_vi: Trước khi nghe C, xác định loại đáp án cần tìm.

items.question: “What time do the games begin?” expects: person / time / place
items.explanation_en: Question starts with WHAT TIME, so expect a time expression.
items.explanation_vi: What time -> đáp án giờ (3 p.m.), không phải tên địa điểm.

items.question: “What does everyone receive?” expects: object / date / price
items.explanation_en: The answer is an item guests are given, a badge.
items.explanation_vi: What ... receive? hỏi vật nhận được, ở clip C là badge.

activities.title: Exam listening: six MCQs
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Recording C. Choose A, B or C for each question.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe clip C, chọn A/B/C cho 6 câu hỏi.

items.question: Event type: A birthday B neighbourhood welcome event C graduation
items.explanation_en: One speaker corrects the birthday assumption; the event welcomes residents.
items.explanation_vi: Birthday là hiểu lầm ban đầu; đáp án cuối welcome event.

items.question: What food do organisers provide? A sandwiches B cake C oranges
items.explanation_en: The speakers say organisers provide sandwiches.
items.explanation_vi: Đề cập sandwiches là đồ ban tổ chức cung cấp; fruit chỉ tự mang nếu muốn.

items.question: What colour must guests wear? A red B blue C any colour
items.explanation_en: There is no dress code, so any colour is allowed.
items.explanation_vi: Không có dress code; đỏ chỉ là khăn của một người.

items.question: What will each guest receive? A badge B scarf C pen
items.explanation_en: Everyone receives a small paper badge.
items.explanation_vi: Badge là thẻ; scarf chỉ do người nói mang.

items.question: What does the badge show? A their street B their group C their age
items.explanation_en: The badge identifies the activity group, not home address or age.
items.explanation_vi: Thẻ cho biết nhóm hoạt động, không phải nơi ở.

items.question: When do the games begin? A 2:00 B 2:30 C 3:00
items.explanation_en: Doors open at 2:30, but games begin at three.
items.explanation_vi: 2:30 giờ mở cửa; 3:00 mới bắt đầu trò chơi.

activities.title: Family lead-in
activities.instruction_en: Say three facts about your family (20 seconds).
activities.instruction_vi: Nói 3 thông tin về gia đình (20 giây).

items.question: Who do you live with?
items.answer: Sample: I live with my parents and my younger brother.
items.explanation_en: A direct short answer should begin with the relevant person.
items.explanation_vi: Trả lời đúng trọng tâm rồi mở rộng, tránh diễn giải lan man.

items.question: Name one activity you enjoy together.
items.answer: Sample: We enjoy cooking dinner on Sundays.
items.explanation_en: Use enjoy + V-ing for activities.
items.explanation_vi: Sau enjoy dùng V-ing: enjoy cooking, không phải enjoy to cook.

activities.title: Descriptive family collocations
activities.instruction_en: Use a natural adjective + noun combination.
activities.instruction_vi: Dùng tính từ + danh từ tự nhiên.

items.question: Choose: a (close / closely) family
items.explanation_en: Close is the adjective modifying family; closely is an adverb.
items.explanation_vi: Đứng trước danh từ family cần tính từ close.

items.question: Finish: My sister is a (reliable / reliably) person.
items.explanation_en: Reliable is an adjective before person.
items.explanation_vi: Reliable là tính từ; reliably là trạng từ.

items.question: Make a collocation with “family”: strong / strongly ____
items.explanation_en: Strong modifies the noun phrase family ties.
items.explanation_vi: Strong family ties = gắn kết gia đình bền chặt.

items.question: In Recording E, which phrase describes a family that supports one another?
items.explanation_en: The candidate says close-knit family: relatives have strong relationships.
items.explanation_vi: Close-knit family = gia đình gắn bó, đoàn kết; đây là adjective + noun collocation.

activities.title: Select appropriate adjectives
activities.instruction_en: Pick the adjective that naturally describes a family.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn tính từ phù hợp để mô tả gia đình.

items.question: We are a (close-knit / costly) family.
items.explanation_en: Close-knit describes family members who support each other.
items.explanation_vi: Close-knit = gắn bó khăng khít; costly dùng cho vật đắt tiền.

items.question: My relatives are very (supportive / supportively).
items.explanation_en: After BE, an adjective describes the subject.
items.explanation_vi: Sau are cần tính từ supportive.

activities.title: Notice frequency in spoken English
activities.instruction_en: Listen to Recording D and answer.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe D và nhận ra cách diễn đạt tần suất.

items.question: How often does the student visit grandparents?
items.explanation_en: The student states this exact frequency.
items.explanation_vi: Twice a month = hai lần mỗi tháng; không nhầm twice a week.

items.question: Which day does the student see a close friend?
items.explanation_en: The student says they meet after school on Wednesdays.
items.explanation_vi: On Wednesdays = vào các ngày thứ Tư.

items.question: Who rarely joins Saturday cooking?
items.explanation_en: The brother works at a cafe, so he rarely attends.
items.explanation_vi: Rarely = hiếm khi; em/anh trai thường bận làm việc.

activities.title: Use frequency naturally
activities.instruction_en: Answer one question with an adverb of frequency and one reason.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời có trạng từ tần suất và một lý do.

items.question: How often do you eat with your family?
items.answer: Sample: We usually eat together in the evening because everyone is home then.
items.explanation_en: Usually precedes EAT; because adds a reason.
items.explanation_vi: Usually đứng trước eat, because giải thích lý do để mở rộng Part 1.

items.question: Do you often call your relatives?
items.answer: Sample: I sometimes call my aunt because she lives far away.
items.explanation_en: Sometimes makes frequency precise; the reason makes the answer natural.
items.explanation_vi: Sometimes thể hiện tần suất vừa phải, có thêm lý do thay vì một từ.

activities.title: Identify question functions
activities.instruction_en: Match each question with its purpose.
activities.instruction_vi: Xác định mục đích câu hỏi Part 1.

items.question: “How often do you visit your cousins?” asks about ____.
items.explanation_en: How often asks how regularly an event occurs.
items.explanation_vi: How often hỏi tần suất.

items.question: “Who are you most similar to?” asks about ____.
items.explanation_en: Who identifies a person; similar to asks for comparison.
items.explanation_vi: Who chỉ người; similar to yêu cầu so sánh đặc điểm.

items.question: “Do you prefer weekends with family or friends?” asks about ____.
items.explanation_en: Prefer requires stating a choice and ideally a reason.
items.explanation_vi: Prefer hỏi sở thích giữa hai lựa chọn; cần chọn và giải thích.

activities.title: Listen and complete notes
activities.instruction_en: Listen to D and note important facts.
activities.instruction_vi: Nghe D rồi hoàn thành ghi chú.

items.question: Saturday cooking usually begins at about ____.
items.explanation_en: The student says “usually around six”.
items.explanation_vi: Around six = khoảng 6 giờ.

items.question: Grandparents live near a ____.
items.explanation_en: The location is given directly.
items.explanation_vi: Small lake = hồ nhỏ, không phải công viên.

items.question: The student and sister both enjoy ____.
items.explanation_en: Both share reading, although their subject preferences differ.
items.explanation_vi: Cùng thích reading; chủ đề đọc khác nhau.

activities.title: Improve a Part 1 answer
activities.instruction_en: Choose the stronger answer and explain.
activities.instruction_vi: Chọn câu trả lời tốt hơn và nêu lý do.

items.question: Q: Do you see your relatives often? A “Yes.” B “Yes, I visit them twice a month because they live nearby.”
items.explanation_en: B answers directly, adds accurate frequency and gives a reason.
items.explanation_vi: B có trực tiếp + tần suất + lý do; A quá ngắn để thể hiện năng lực.

items.question: Q: Are you close to your sister? A “She is nice and we talk every evening.” B “I will explain the history of all my ancestors.”
items.explanation_en: A stays on topic; B goes far beyond the question.
items.explanation_vi: A đúng trọng tâm; B lạc đề.

items.question: In Recording F, which student gives the best answer and why?
items.explanation_en: Student two stays on topic, adds frequency, a specific activity and a reason; student one is too short and student three is off topic.
items.explanation_vi: Bạn số 2 trả lời đúng câu hỏi, có tần suất và ví dụ; số 1 quá ngắn, số 3 lạc đề.

activities.title: Connect ideas
activities.instruction_en: Complete with because, but, so, or although.
activities.instruction_vi: Điền liên từ theo nghĩa.

items.question: We call every weekend ____ we live in different cities.
items.explanation_en: Because gives the reason for the calls.
items.explanation_vi: Because + mệnh đề chỉ lý do: vì ở khác thành phố.

items.question: My brother is busy, ____ we still meet for lunch on Sundays.
items.explanation_en: But introduces contrast.
items.explanation_vi: But nối hai ý tương phản: bận nhưng vẫn gặp.

items.question: I missed my grandmother, ____ I called her yesterday.
items.explanation_en: So introduces the result of missing someone.
items.explanation_vi: So = vì vậy, chỉ kết quả.

items.question: ____ we have different hobbies, we enjoy spending time together.
items.explanation_en: Although creates a concessive relationship.
items.explanation_vi: Although = mặc dù; không dùng thêm but ở mệnh đề sau.

activities.title: Third-person -s endings
activities.instruction_en: Classify final sounds as /s/, /z/, or /ɪz/.
activities.instruction_vi: Phân loại cách đọc đuôi -s.

items.question: cooks /s/ or /z/ or /ɪz/?
items.explanation_en: The root ends in voiceless /k/, so -s sounds /s/.
items.explanation_vi: Cook kết thúc /k/ vô thanh -> cooks /s/.

items.question: plays /s/ or /z/ or /ɪz/?
items.explanation_en: Play ends in a vowel sound, so -s is voiced /z/.
items.explanation_vi: Play kết thúc nguyên âm /eɪ/ -> plays /z/.

items.question: watches /s/ or /z/ or /ɪz/?
items.explanation_en: Watch ends in /tʃ/, requiring an extra syllable /ɪz/.
items.explanation_vi: Watch kết thúc /tʃ/ -> watches /ɪz/ thêm một âm tiết.

activities.title: Read sentences aloud
activities.instruction_en: Read each sentence. Focus on the -s ending.
activities.instruction_vi: Đọc to từng câu, chú ý đuôi -s.

items.question: She cooks dinner and plays music every evening.
items.explanation_en: The final consonant of the base verb determines the ending sound.
items.explanation_vi: Cooks /s/ (sau /k/); plays /z/ (sau nguyên âm).

items.question: My brother watches films and visits our aunt.
items.explanation_en: Watches ends /ɪz/; visits ends /s/ after /t/.
items.explanation_vi: Watches /ɪz/; visits /s/ do visit kết thúc /t/.

activities.title: Practice meaningful questions
activities.instruction_en: Answer each in 2-3 sentences with a concrete detail.
activities.instruction_vi: Trả lời 2–3 câu, có ví dụ cụ thể.

items.question: What do different members of your family enjoy doing?
items.answer: Sample: My mother enjoys gardening, while my father likes cycling. We sometimes do both activities together on Sundays.
items.explanation_en: Give contrasts and specific examples; do not list isolated vocabulary.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu ví dụ thực tế và kết nối ý, không chỉ đọc danh sách từ.

items.question: What do family members usually talk about?
items.answer: Sample: We usually talk about work and school over dinner. I also ask my father for advice when I have a problem.
items.explanation_en: Describe topic + time + example for natural fluency.
items.explanation_vi: Dùng ý chủ đề + thời điểm + ví dụ để câu trả lời đầy đủ.

activities.title: Mini speaking mock: Part 1
activities.instruction_en: Record five Part 1 answers, around 15–25 seconds each.
activities.instruction_vi: Ghi âm 5 câu Part 1, khoảng 15–25 giây mỗi câu.

items.question: Do you have a large family?
items.answer: Sample: Not really. There are four people in my immediate family, so we are quite a small family.
items.explanation_en: Direct answer plus detail works better than a one-word response.
items.explanation_vi: Trả lời trực tiếp và có thông tin mở rộng; không học thuộc cứng.

items.question: What do you often do with your family?
items.answer: Sample: We often have dinner together and talk about our day. It helps us stay close.
items.explanation_en: Add an example and a reason.
items.explanation_vi: Nêu thói quen và lợi ích với gia đình.

items.question: How often do you meet older relatives?
items.answer: Sample: I meet my grandparents about twice a month because they live in another district.
items.explanation_en: Frequency and a reason answer the question precisely.
items.explanation_vi: Twice a month là tần suất cụ thể; because giải thích.

items.question: Who do you feel closest to?
items.answer: Sample: I feel closest to my older sister because she listens to me and gives practical advice.
items.explanation_en: Name the person and explain the relationship.

model_writing_task1:
The diagram illustrates the production of reusable cloth gift bags from second-hand cotton fabric. Overall, the process consists of eight stages, beginning with the collection of used material and ending with the delivery of the finished products. The main activities can be divided into preparation, manufacturing and final checking.

First, pieces of used cotton are collected from different sources. They are then sorted and inspected to make sure that suitable fabric is available. At the third stage, the selected pieces are washed in warm water. After cleaning, the fabric is placed in the sunlight until it is dry.

Next, the dry material is cut into appropriate shapes using templates. The separate pieces are stitched together, and handles are added to create the bags. Before the bags are sent out, each product is checked for defects. Any bags that pass this inspection are packed carefully. Finally, the completed reusable bags are delivered to their destination. No information is given about the time required for each stage.
